peer_identity.arc_label: Supreme Metabaron operating in Steelhead's time—identity explicitly unresolved in vol14
peer_identity.honcho_notes: Relies on speed and maneuverability rather than brute force. Tactically precise—exploits turning radius as a time advantage. Protective of Milady; commands her to follow his exact path. Generates lethal spherical energy field. Addresses subordinates in guiding/commanding tone. Whether this is Steelhead in his Metabaron role or a distinct figure is unresolved.
peer_identity.rationale: This record is explicitly flagged as uncertain whether it depicts Steelhead or a separate figure ('The Metabaron, Supreme Metabaron, Petro (possible)'). The vol14 narrative itself marks this as unresolved. Cannot safely merge with the No-Name Metabaron (different era) nor with the Steelhead card (unconfirmed identity). Split_uncertain because the source record's own analysis declares the identity open.

appearances: Heavily armored figure commanding Metacraft in space combat (vol.14 p04-p05)
Addressed formally as 'Supreme Metabaron' during technomonk confrontation (vol.14 p13)
Heavy armored cyborg warrior on foot, physically very heavy — weight noted as a mobility limitation (vol.14 p09)
Generates or activates a lethal spherical energy field capable of killing guards en masse (vol.14 p09)
Uses energy weapon fire and fights through golden organic bio-mechanical structures (vol.14 p10)
important_actions: Ordered Metacraft to execute an immediate about-turn against the merged petro-morph ship, exploiting size and speed advantage (vol.14 p04-p05)
Breached Amalek XII's sealed techno-temple and fought through technopapal guardians (vol.14 p08-p13)
Expelled a small figure through a vertical shaft inside the organic structure (vol.14 p10)
Destroyed the technoscarab and threatened Amalek XII with total destruction unless he appeared (vol.14 p12)
Activated pan-atomic anti-shield and repelled technomonk kidnapping attempt; leader immediately capitulated (vol.14 p13)
knowledge_boundaries: Whether this is the same person as Melmoth/Steelhead or a distinct figure is an open uncertainty in this volume
The mechanism of the spherical defensive energy field is not named or explained in any page
relationships: Tonto serves as observer/adviser aboard Metacraft (vol.14 p04-p05)
Acts as protector-superior to Milady (vol.14 p09, p10)
Possibly the same individual as Melmoth/Steelhead — explicitly unresolved in this volume (open uncertainty)
The 'current Metabaron' referenced by Tonto and Lothar is a separate later figure whose identity is distinct from the historical Steelhead (vol.14 p24)
traits: Relies on speed and maneuverability rather than brute force in ship combat (vol.14 p04-p05)
Tactically precise: exploits opponent's turning radius as a decisive time advantage (vol.14 p04-p05)
Disciplined and protective toward Milady; insists she stay within his exact path (vol.14 p09)
Forceful and confrontational: prefers demand over polite request when approaching authority figures (vol.14 p11)
Does not retreat when threatened; presses forward despite obstacles (vol.14 p11, p13)
Confident when direct assault routes seem impossible; reframes the problem tactically (vol.14 p09)
voice_notes: On tactics: orders Metacraft to flee because the enemy is too powerful to engage head-on without losing too much time (vol.14 p04-p05)
On access to the temple: 'If we cannot go up, our enemies will come down to us' (vol.14 p09)
Invokes 'mega-mortis' as an escalated offensive mode while protected by the pan-atomic anti-shield (vol.14 p13)
Addresses Milady in a guiding/commanding tone: 'follow your braggart' (approximate, vol.14 p10)
witnessed_facts: Observed petro-morphs merging into a gigantic combined vessel via Tonto's report (vol.14 p04-p05)
Landed at Amalek XII's sealed techno-temple; temple defense systems deployed weapons and paralysis gas against Metacraft (vol.14 p08)
Killed technopapal guardians en masse with a spherical energy field (vol.14 p09)
Destroyed a large biomechanical technoscarab deployed as a defensive creature (vol.14 p12)
Technomonk faction attempted to kidnap him; leader capitulated after a blast dispersed them (vol.14 p13)
